title: A label with a spending rule
hook: Two stated cases: explore a label’s effect under an explicit allocation rule.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a label’s effect under an explicit allocation rule affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Shortfall, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a label’s effect under an explicit allocation rule in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
